capabilities: Export the current note to a Hugo project as a Page Bundle
Convert wikilinks and image embeds to Hugo-compatible Markdown links
Strip privacy metadata from referenced images and copy them with hashed names
Review final Markdown with an OpenAI-compatible AI for sensitive content and PII
Apply word replacement rules and conflict-safe export directory names
extras: Desktop-only because it writes to a Hugo project outside the vault. Release assets include GitHub artifact attestations; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. AI review is enabled by default and sends the final Markdown to the configured endpoint.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a Hugo static site with converted links, bundled images, and privacy screening before publishing.

relations.evidence: Exports notes and images from your vault to a Hugo site using Hugo's Page Bundles structure.
DeepSeek, compatible gateways, Ollama, LM Studio, and similar services automatically use or fall back

summary: Exports notes and images to a Hugo site as Page Bundles, with optional AI review for sensitive content and local image metadata cleaning.
